channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede ao STF para anular sua condenação a 27 anos
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro has asked the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to annul his 27-year prison sentence for attempted coup. The appeal was filed on Friday, June 8, and claims procedural irregularities in the case. The STF’s ruling could significantly affect the 2026 Brazilian elections.

item.title: Lei da Dosimetria começa a valer; entenda o que muda para Bolsonaro e condenados por golpe
item.description: The Dosimetry Law came into effect on Friday (8) and allows for reduced sentences for those convicted in the January 8, 2023 attacks, preventing the cumulative punishment for the crimes of violent abolition of the democratic rule of law and coup d'état when committed in the same context. The measure could benefit former President Jair Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years and three months for a coup plot, although the reduction is not automatic and requires activation by the STF.

item.title: Flávio tenta descolar Ciro Nogueira de eleição e diz não poder responder por atos de quem tem proximidade
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a presidential pre-candidate, sought to distance himself from allegations involving Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) in the Master case, stating he cannot be held responsible for the actions of allies. He made the remarks during a pre-campaign event in Florianópolis, avoiding comment on Nogueira’s alleged involvement in the investigation.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro entra com novo recurso no STF para anular condenação por tentativa de golpe
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense filed a new petition with the STF, asking Minister Edson Fachin to annul his 27-year prison sentence for alleged coup attempt. The appeal seeks to overturn the conviction accusing him of orchestrating actions to subvert the 2022 election results. The defense claims procedural flaws and lack of concrete evidence.

item.title: Endividamento atinge 80,9% em abril e bate recorde
item.description: In April 2026, 80.9% of Brazilian households were in debt, a new historical record, with credit cards as the main source of indebtedness. Debt increased across all income brackets, reaching 83.6% among those earning up to three minimum wages. President Lula intensified his rhetoric against household debt, linking it to declining popularity (61% disapproval) and election-year strategy, while announcing the Desenrola 2.0 debt renegotiation program.

item.title: Lula relata diálogo com Trump sobre idade: “A natureza é implacável”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated that he spoke with Donald Trump about the issue of age, emphasizing that he does not seek direct conflict with the United States but rather a dispute over narrative and facts. He said it was necessary to put the truth on the table and told Trump: 'I don’t want war with you. I know you...', implying that nature is merciless in the face of reality.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede revisão criminal ao STF com análise por Segunda Turma
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro filed a criminal revision request with the STF, claiming the conviction is void due to the alleged lack of jurisdiction of the First Chamber to judge presidential acts, arguing the case should have been tried by the Full Court. They also challenge the validity of Mauro Cid’s plea bargain, citing lack of voluntariness and incomplete disclosure of evidence, and claim the final judgment was prematurely issued. The request asks for review by the Second Chamber, despite constitutional rules requiring such revisions to be decided by the Plenary.

item.title: “Tivemos uma ótima reunião”, diz Trump sobre encontro com Lula
item.description: President Donald Trump said he had a great meeting with President Lula at the White House, stating that the Brazilian government wants to do business with the United States. He added that they will see how the negotiations unfold.

item.title: Relator de ações que questionam Lei da Dosimetria, Moraes pede informações à Presidência e ao Congresso
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has been appointed rapporteur of challenges to the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks. He has requested information from the Presidency and Congress, with a 5-day deadline for response, followed by 3 days for the PGR and AGU to respond. The law, vetoed by Lula but overridden by Congress, benefits Bolsonaro’s allies, including his 27-year-and-three-month sentence.

item.title: Governo renova contratos de energia em 13 estados; Enel fica de fora
item.description: The federal government renewed contracts with 16 electricity distributors across 13 states, including Pará, Maranhão, Pernambuco, and Bahia, projecting R$130 billion in investments through 2030 to modernize the power grid. The renewal, announced by President Lula and Minister Alexandre Silveira, introduces stricter quality standards, including consumer satisfaction measured by neighborhood, continuous improvement, post-extreme weather service restoration, and grid digitization. Enel was excluded from the new contracts.

item.title: Flávio comenta declaração sobre Ciro para vice: “Uma cortesia”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that mentioning Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) as a potential running mate was merely a 'courtesy', with no concrete decision made. He emphasized that no agreement or definition exists yet for the 2026 ticket, despite having previously floated the idea in an old interview.

item.title: Moraes será o relator de ações no STF contra a dosimetria
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes will serve as rapporteur for actions filed by PSOL and ABI against the dosimetria law, which reduces sentences and eases regime progression for those involved in the January 8 attacks. The petitioners claim the law trivializes crimes against the democratic state and violates constitutional individualization of punishment. The law was promulgated by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre following the override of Lula’s veto.

item.title: Flávio assiste à pré-estreia de documentário sobre Bolsonaro em SC
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro attended the pre-premiere of the documentary 'A Colisão dos Destinos', which portrays the life of his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, in Santa Catarina. The event was attended by his brother Carlos Bolsonaro and other PL leaders, with the film produced by federal deputy Mário Frias. The national premiere is scheduled for May 14 in theaters nationwide.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede revisão de condenação no STF
item.description: Bolsonaro's lawyers filed a criminal revision request at the STF to contest his 27-year-and-3-month prison sentence, citing procedural nullities in the case.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede que STF anule pena de 27 anos
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro filed a criminal revision petition with the STF seeking to annul his 27-year and 3-month prison sentence, citing defense restraint, improper jurisdiction by the 1st Chamber, and the invalidity of Mauro Cid's plea bargain. The petition references the newly promulgated Dosimetry Law as a potential mitigating factor and, if the main request is denied, asks for acquittal on charges of coup attempt, armed criminal organization, and attempting to abolish the democratic rule of law.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede ao STF para anular condenação de 27 anos de prisão pela trama golpista
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro has asked the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to annul his 27-year prison sentence for attempting a coup d'état, citing procedural irregularities and denial of defense. The lawyers request a criminal review, a new rapporteur in the Second Chamber, and the annulment of evidence derived from the plea deal of Lieutenant Colonel Mauro Cid. If denied, they seek full acquittal on charges of armed criminal organization, coup attempt, and violent abolition of the democratic rule of law.

item.title: Malafaia critica pastora que orientou mulheres a denunciar violência
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia criticized Pastor Helena Raquel for claiming that 43% of evangelical women suffer domestic violence, calling the data a 'trashy study' and her statement 'indecency'. Helena Raquel, citing a 2025 report from the Brazilian Public Security Forum, urged victims to report abuse and leave violent environments, stating the church must be a place of healing, not fear. Malafaia's video surpassed 1 million views.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: CEO da Quaest aponta os três grupos de eleitores que vão definir a eleição
item.description: The 2026 presidential election remains open, with 43% of voters still able to change their vote, according to Felipe Nunes, CEO of Quaest. Although Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro concentrate nearly 80% of voting intentions, the outcome will be decided by independent voters, less ideological youth, and moderates who reject both poles and decide based on the economy and concrete proposals. Key battleground regions include São Paulo, Belo Horizonte, and the industrial zone of Salvador.

item.title: Lula diz que falou a Trump que não quer guerra com os EUA
item.description: President Lula stated that he told Donald Trump he does not want war with the U.S., but rather a debate based on arguments and facts, emphasizing that he avoided impulsive reactions after the tariff announcement. He noted that he challenged U.S. data on bilateral trade deficits, showing the U.S. was mistaken, and affirmed that relations with Washington are grounded in mutual respect, open to discussing sensitive issues like big techs and organized crime. Lula also urged foreign investors to choose Brazil as a platform, rejecting the 'banana republic' label.

item.title: Flávio propõe reduzir ministérios de 39 para 27 se eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential pre-candidate from the PL party, proposed reducing the number of federal ministries from 39 to 27 to cut government spending, stating the plan is still being drafted and noting that former President Jair Bolsonaro implemented a similar reduction in 2019.

item.title: “Tenho preferência por uma vice”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) reiterated his preference for a woman as his running mate in the 2026 presidential race, though he emphasized that the name has not yet been finalized. He stated he has been reflecting on the choice based on recent polls.

item.title: Após promulgação da dosimetria, ‘Débora do batom’ faz novo pedido de redução de pena
item.description: The lawyers of Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do Batom', filed a new request with the STF for sentence reduction following the promulgation of the Dosimetry Law by the Senate. She was sentenced to 14 years in prison for her participation in the January 8th coup attempt, including graffiti on the Justice statue reading 'lost, man'. Currently under house arrest, her defense argues the new law would reduce her sentence, although Justice Alexandre de Moraes previously denied a similar request because the law had not yet been promulgated.

item.title: Silveira diz que biocombustíveis são resposta para guerra no Irã
item.description: Minister Alexandre Silveira stated that biofuels represent a robust response to rising fossil fuel prices driven by the war between the U.S., Israel, and Iran. He highlighted progress under the Future Fuel Law, which promotes ethanol, biodiesel, SAF, green diesel, and biogas, with potential to unlock R$260 billion in investments by 2037. The policy aims to shield Brazilian consumers from global oil price volatility tied to Middle Eastern conflicts they did not cause.

item.title: Por Dentro das Eleições: saiba de onde podem vir os recursos de campanha
item.description: TSE Resolution No. 23.607/2019 establishes permitted funding sources for electoral campaigns in the 2026 elections, allowing only candidates' own resources, donations from individuals within legal limits, and party fund resources. Fundraising may only begin after fulfilling requirements such as candidate registration, CNPJ registration, a dedicated campaign bank account, and issuing electoral receipts, ensuring transparency and oversight by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: “Quem quiser fazer negócio no Brasil, venha”, diz Lula a investidores
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva invited foreign investors to do business in Brazil, emphasizing the country’s openness to partnerships with any nation willing to bring technology, not just the United States. He stated that Brazil aims to become a global platform for multinational companies, citing confidence in the business sector and the early renewal of concession contracts for 14 electricity distributors as evidence of this commitment. Lula also stressed that the government does not want national energy dominated by foreign interests and expressed willingness to discuss sensitive topics like big tech and organized crime with the U.S. on a basis of mutual respect.

item.title: Lula critica violência machista com preconceito machista
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized machismo during a public event, but by claiming that 'there is no experience of a woman beating a man' and that abused men would stay silent out of shame, he reproduced a macho prejudice. His remarks, made while laughing, sparked controversy by dismissing the possibility of domestic violence against men and reinforcing gender stereotypes. The comment was made in a context dedicated to combating violence against women, making the contradiction particularly glaring.

item.title: "Ninguém respeita lambe-botas", diz Lula sobre reunião com Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva emphasized the frank conversation with Donald Trump at the White House, stating there are no vetoes on discussing topics such as big techs, organized crime, and trade tariffs. He reiterated Brazil’s openness to business with all countries, provided Brazilian sovereignty is respected, and criticized those who seek to please everyone without principles, saying: 'Nobody respects bootlickers'.

item.title: Flávio diz que será ele o presidente caso eleito, não o pai
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that if elected president in 2026, he would hold the office himself, not his father Jair Bolsonaro. He said the former president would serve as his 'advisor' and could occupy any position he desires in his administration, praising his unmatched political experience. Flávio did not confirm whether he had already discussed with his father the possibility of taking a ministerial role.

item.title: Flávio diz que, se eleito, Bolsonaro pode ocupar um cargo em seu governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL-RJ presidential pre-candidate, stated that if elected, his father Jair Bolsonaro could hold a position in his government. He described Jair Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years in prison for the coup attempt and currently under house arrest, as his 'best adviser' and said he would work for a broad amnesty so his father could 'climb the ramp of the Palace.' Flávio said he has never directly asked Jair if he would accept a role, but believes he would provide constant counsel.

item.title: Lindbergh acusa Flávio de mentir sobre apoio à CPMI do Banco Master
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) of lying by claiming the PT refused to support the creation of the CPMI on Banco Master, stating that the agreement between bolsonarism and centrão to bury the commission was poorly received. Lindbergh denied the PT opposed the investigation and said the senator distorts reality to serve political interests.

item.title: Trama golpista: defesa pede anulação de condenação e que Bolsonaro seja absolvido
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro has requested a criminal review from the Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) to overturn his conviction for attempted coup d'état, claiming judicial error and lack of jurisdiction by the First Chamber. They seek annulment of the trial, nullification of Mauro Cid's plea bargain, and Bolsonaro's acquittal, citing violation of defense rights and arguing the case should be heard by the full Court. Criminal review is an exceptional remedy available only after a sentence has become final and unappealable.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro entra com revisão criminal para anular condenação após Dosimetria ser promulgada
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro filed a criminal revision petition at the STF to overturn his 27-year prison sentence following the promulgation of the Dosimetry Law. The appeal seeks to re-examine a final judgment, alleging procedural or legal flaws in the sentencing. The report is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Flávio: Se Jair Bolsonaro quiser exercer cargo no meu governo, é óbvio que vai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, admitted he would appoint former president Jair Bolsonaro to a position in his potential government if the father wished to hold public office. The statement was made on Friday, the 8th, reinforcing the possibility of a family ticket in the 2026 presidential race. Flávio emphasized that such an appointment would be 'obvious' if Jair expressed interest.

item.title: Defesa de Jair Bolsonaro protocola revisão criminal no STF e pede relatoria para ministro da Segunda Turma
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense filed a criminal review petition at the STF against his conviction for attempted coup d'état, requesting that the case be assigned to a minister of the Second Turma, citing procedural nullities and defense restrictions. Criminal review is an exceptional remedy rarely successful, particularly given the gravity of the case and STF precedent on coup-related offenses. Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years and 3 months in prison in November 2023.

item.title: Clica e Confirma destaca o término da gestão da ministra Cármen Lúcia como presidente do TSE
item.description: The Clica e Confirma program highlighted the end of Minister Cármen Lúcia's term as president of the TSE, concluding her second term that began in June 2024. It also covered the upcoming swearing-in of Minister Nunes Marques as the new TSE president on Tuesday (12), with Minister André Mendonça as vice-president, the unveiling of the 2026 elections mascot 'Pilili', and an interview on the new Conta Mais JE campaign finance system.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia dá 5 dias para Moro responder ação em que é acusado de caluniar Gilmar
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia has ordered Senator Sergio Moro to present a preliminary defense within five days in a criminal defamation case against Minister Gilmar Mendes, following the rejection of Moro's appeals by the STF's First Chamber. The case stems from a 2023 video in which Moro stated he could 'buy a habeas corpus' from Gilmar, which the Prosecutor General's Office interprets as an accusation of passive corruption. Moro claimed the remark was an 'unfortunate joke' and apologized, but the STF asserts jurisdiction because the video became public during his senatorial term.

item.title: Flávio diz que tentará anistia de Bolsonaro se eleito e que pode dar a ele um cargo no governo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, stated that if elected, he would seek amnesty for his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who was convicted by the STF over the January 8 attacks, to enable his appointment to a government position. He also said he aims to reduce the number of ministries from 39 to 27, use federal real estate assets to generate revenue, and implement technological compliance tools to monitor public spending.

item.title: Messi revela suas maiores apostas para ganhar a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Lionel Messi stated that France and Spain are his top picks to win the 2026 World Cup, citing their high-level squads. He acknowledged Argentina arrives well and can dream of the title, but believes other teams are in better form. Messi also noted Brazil remains a title contender despite not being at its peak, and reaffirmed his passion for the game, saying he intends to play as long as his body allows.

item.title: Lula diz que Enel não cumpriu nada do que prometeu
item.description: President Lula criticized Enel for failing to fulfill any of its promises to the government during the 'Sente a Energia' event in Brasília. The company was excluded from the early renewal of concession contracts for 14 electricity distributors, involving R$130 billion in investments through 2030. Lula emphasized that the new agreements include stricter quality targets, and non-compliance could lead to concession revocation.

item.title: “Temos que desaprender a ideia de que o homem é superior”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula called for unlearning the idea of male superiority, stating that violence against women is a men's issue and that jealousy is a disease. He criticized the cultural upbringing that teaches men to feel ownership over women and emphasized respect and love in relationships. The speech, delivered at the 'Sente a Energia' event ahead of the 2026 elections, aligns with the government's strategy to focus on women's living conditions and reducing female workload.

item.title: Governadora do DF insiste em reunião com Lula em busca de ajuda para tentar salvar BRB
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão (PP), is seeking a meeting with President Lula to obtain federal assistance for the capitalization of the Bank of Brasília (BRB), which needs R$ 8.8 billion by the end of the month to cover losses from operations with Master. Despite local government pressure, the Planalto Palace has not yet confirmed the meeting, and the economic team has signaled that the National Treasury will not approve the R$ 6.6 billion loan via the FGC, advocating that any solution must come from the Central Bank, such as intervention and subsequent federalization.

item.title: Lula atribui caso Master à gestão Bolsonaro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva blamed the Jair Bolsonaro administration for irregularities under investigation in the Banco Master case, stating that the alleged frauds originated in the previous government. The statement was read by Federal Police Director General Andrei Rodrigues during a graduation ceremony at the National Police Academy in Brasília.

item.title: Governo cassará distribuidoras de energia que falharem com frequência
item.description: The federal government announced it will cancel concessions of electricity distributors that repeatedly fail to provide adequate service, under a presidential decree renewing contracts for 16 companies across 13 states. The new rules establish strict criteria for service continuity (FEC and DEC), economic-financial management, climate resilience, rural service, and energy inclusion, with heavy fines and potential contract termination for extreme non-compliance. Minister Alexandre Silveira stated the decree equips Aneel with tools to hold distributors accountable, rendering previous contracts obsolete.

item.title: Flávio diz que prefere mulher como vice e comenta caso Ciro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he prefers a woman as his vice-presidential running mate and said the decision will be made closer to party conventions. He commented on the investigations against Ciro Nogueira, asserting that Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, the case’s rapporteur, will act within the law, and emphasized he is not negotiating individual support with Nogueira but with the Progressistas-União Brasil federation.

item.title: Lula diz que falou a Trump que não quer 'guerra' com ele e que sua disputa é 'na narrativa'
item.description: President Lula stated that in his meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, he told Trump he does not seek 'war' with him, but a dispute 'in the narrative,' arguing that Brazil has a trade surplus with the U.S., not a deficit. He described the meeting as productive and reassuring, emphasizing cooperation on organized crime and tariffs, with the next 30 days being crucial for trade negotiations.

item.title: Não quero guerra, quero provar que estamos certos, diz Lula sobre Trump
item.description: President Lula told Donald Trump that Brazil does not seek war with the U.S., but wants to prove it is right regarding trade claims. He noted the trade balance favors the U.S. and called the American justification for tariffs a mistake. Lula gave 30 days to resolve the tariff issue, with a follow-up talk planned.

item.title: Ouvidoria em Foco: busca por regularização eleitoral provoca aumento nos atendimentos do TSE
item.description: The TSE Ombudsman recorded 2,604 attendances between May 1 and 7, exceeding more than half of April’s total demand. The surge was driven by citizens seeking electoral regularization before the voter registry closure, with 80.3% of requests related to voter enrollment, data review, address transfer, and biometric collection. Phone contact was the dominant channel, accounting for 1,688 calls (70.5% of total), a 39.8% increase compared to April.

item.title: Nunes Marques arquiva ação de Bolsonaro contra Lula e Gleisi no STF por crimes contra a honra
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Nunes Marques dismissed a lawsuit filed by former President Jair Bolsonaro against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann on charges of crimes against honor, following the recommendation of the Attorney General’s Office. The ruling was issued on Thursday, November 7, and terminated the case without substantive review. The decision reflects the Court’s pattern of rejecting politically motivated claims with little legal merit.

item.title: TSE realiza Teste de Confirmação do Teste Público da Urna de 13 a 15 de maio
item.description: The TSE is conducting the Confirmation Test of the 2025 Electronic Voting Machine Public Test from May 13 to 15, where researchers return to validate corrections and improvements made to the electoral systems following the December 2025 phase. The goal is to confirm that identified vulnerabilities have been effectively addressed in time for the 2026 General Elections, scheduled for October 4 and 25 (first and second rounds). Journalists wishing to attend must register by 8 a.m. on May 13 to access the Electoral Dissemination Center in Brasília.

item.title: Lei da Dosimetria é publicada e passa a valer mas redução de penas não é automática; entenda
item.description: The Dosimetry Law was promulgated and published in the Official Gazette, officially taking effect, but sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8 attacks are not automatic and require action by the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to recalculate penalties. At least 190 people, including Jair Bolsonaro and his allies, could benefit, although a request by the defense of Debora Rodrigues dos Santos was previously rejected due to the law not yet being in force.
